body:
It’s been an amazing month … talking about Why Did Jesus, Moses, the Buddha, and Mohammed Cross the Road (Christian Identity in a Multi-Faith World) in New York, DC, Boston, St. Louis, Jefferson City, Grand Rapids, South Bend, Berkeley, San Francisco, Los Angeles, San Diego, Chicago, Denver, Phoenix, Austin, and Oklahoma City … I feel like singing the old Johnny Cash song …

I’ll have a day at home, and then will be in Dallas (Wed.) and Miami (Fri.) next week. (Hope to see you there! More info here… ) Thanks to all who have made this tour a pleasure, especially the event hosts and my friends at LTM, Jericho, and Creative Trust.
